title: timing-safe dummy hash with cost-matching
description: The CredentialStore always runs bcrypt::verify for unknown usernames using a dummy hash computed at the same cost factor as the real hashes. The cost is extracted at store construction time, not hardcoded, so it tracks operator cost-factor rotation automatically. The DECISION comment documents the invariant and warns against adding an early return. A future contributor might see the extra bcrypt work for unknown users and 'optimize' it away, creating a timing oracle. The comment and code structure together make that mistake difficult.
